items.vietnam_context: Vietnam road safety demonstration scene along a highway with scenic mountains in background, showing multiple commuters on motorbikes wearing safety helmets, including a mother carrying two young children with helmets on a motorcycle loaded with school backpacks, a man on a bright cyan Honda Wave, and a woman in orange on a red scooter.
